_doc: Round-2 blind plan (matched, settled states). Same step grammar as blind-plan.json. Refs are the status-bar/device-chrome-cropped copies made by review/out/round-2/crop.mjs (crop boxes in review/out/round-2/crops.json), addressed relative to review/refs/duolingo/. Dropped vs round 1 (no clean, settled ref with its primary action visible): focus in-session (timer-in-session crop hides CHECK), break running, nook (no comparable), stats streak calendar (streak-calendar-repaired is an infographic), and GIF mid-animation frames (lesson-end-walk, streak-extended, quests-chest-open). `state` is copied into the key per pair.

screens.kind: onboarding: one question per screen, an option chosen
screens.state: Kettle: daily-goal step, 'A cup' chosen, Continue enabled, entrance settled. Duo: course/goal pick with one option selected (where-to-start: none selected, CTA enabled).
Kettle: notifications step (permission state 'default'), both actions visible. Duo: reminders priming screen with Continue.

screens.kind: home / today screen of a daily-habit app (main call to action)
screens.state: Kettle: veteran profile mid-day, goal part-done, top of page, no toast. Duo: path home with START bubble, mid-unit progress.

screens.kind: daily quests / daily challenges list with mixed progress
screens.state: Kettle: Today's recipes card scrolled to top, 1 done / 2 partial. Duo: daily + friends/monthly quests with partial progress.

steps.eval: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3')].find(e => /recipes/i.test(e.textContent)); const card = h && (h.closest('section,article,[class*=card]') || h); card && card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); })()

screens.kind: confirmation sheet when leaving a session early
screens.state: Kettle: end-early sheet 6 min into a brew, sheet fully open. Duo: quit-lesson sheet, fully open.
Kettle: card 1 after tiles and receipt finished counting. Duo: lesson complete card (+XP, streak ring, week row).
Kettle: warm-streak card after number flip and week row filled. Duo: '3 day streak' ring + week row + CONTINUE (same ref as results; it is Duo's streak moment).

screens.kind: reward moment: daily quests / chest opened
screens.state: Kettle: recipes card after tin opened and bars filled. Duo: reward card after chest opened (+10 energy, Continue).
Kettle: level-up card with nook preview rendered. Duo: reward card after chest opened.

screens.kind: interstitial between sessions: mascot + next step
screens.state: Kettle: 'Break's over' after a short tea break, 3D room rendered. Duo: practice-session intro (mascot + bubble + CONTINUE) and timed side-quest intro (PLAY).
Kettle: stats top of page, veteran, counters settled. Duo: profile with overview/statistics tiles.
Kettle: Badges section scrolled to top (6 tiered badges + personal bests below). Duo: achievements page (personal records + awards grid).

steps.eval: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3')].find(e => /^badges/i.test(e.textContent.trim())); const card = h && (h.closest('section,article,[class*=card]') || h); card && card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); })()

screens.state: Kettle: settings top of page. Duo: settings menu, preferences toggles, reminders list.
